entity: US rail trespasser deaths, 2017 to 2025: rising while other rail casualties fell
what_we_add: the 26% rise 2017-2025 and the all-41-Brightline-2024-deaths-were-trespassers cut - no source states the trend number
why: CRS states the same finding in words: trespasser deaths not falling while other rail deaths dropped. Operation Lifesaver's preliminary 2025 count (793) sits within 25% of our 838, same direction. WLRN's 49 Brightline deaths counts all deaths, not trespassers-only, so no contradiction with our 41.
